$comment: Family homework 'Learn more online' links. Source of truth: this file; code: scripts/homework-external-resources.mjs; gate: tools/validate-family-resources.mjs.
Every link is a specific Khan Academy video or article for the lesson's own topic. A lesson with no verified on-topic resource lists none and the page shows no links section at all.
resources[id].topics are the topics a resource really teaches; lessons[id].topics are what the lesson teaches. A linked resource must share a topic with its lesson. At most 2 links per lesson.

verification is recorded by scripts/verify-family-resources.mjs (Joel runs it; it needs a network and a browser). Khan Academy answers HTTP 200 for every path and shows 'Page not found' inside the page, so the script reads the rendered page. The gate reads only this record and fails entries older than 180 days.
urlEs is the same page on es.khanacademy.org, present only when it was verified to exist; the Spanish-mode link uses it.
Part 2 / part 3 pages use their core lesson's entry. Unit 10 is not taught: no links.
